checkpoint: v2.57 candidate signature and package verification gap

checks.v1_jarsigner: PASS with expected warnings for self-signed local test certificate and no timestamp
checks.v2_local_verifier: PASS as reported in prior build record; signer signature, certificate/public-key match, chunked content digest and signing-block geometry checked
checks.official_apksigner: NOT RUN: tool absent in current environment; outbound shell DNS/download unavailable

interpretation: ZIP and v1 JAR signature checks can pass while Android package installation still fails.
The previous v2 verifier is project-local and is not equivalent to a run of official Android apksigner.

A different local signing certificate prevents in-place updates over a differently signed installed package, but it does not by itself explain a failed fresh install after the old package was uninstalled.
Do not assign root cause until official apksigner output and/or the device's PackageManager install failure code are collected.
next_gate: Run official apksigner verify --verbose --print-certs on the exact candidate file. If that passes, capture the real installation failure via v2.65 mode 1 on the device. If the package installs and Start remains inert, use mode 2.
